name: csv_column_selector
description: selects the value of a column from a csv file

inputs.label: input_string
inputs.description: input string including column names and values

inputs.label: column_name
inputs.description: name of the column to select the value from the input string

inputs.label: separator
inputs.description: separator used in the input string to separate column names and values, e.g., ',' or ';' for csv file content. If empty ('') automatic detection is used

outputs.label: column_value
outputs.description: value of the selected column from the input string

program.label: prog_csv_column_selector
program.description: program that does not wait for sync to select the value of a column from an input string that includes column names and values, e.g., a csv file content

attachments.label: attachment_csv_column_selector
attachments.description: Selector waits for no sync and selects the value of a column from an input string that includes column names and values, e.g., a csv file content
